    MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.familyCriterion_A0

    Proposition 7.9 on A₀ for an arbitrary family #

    prop:family-criterion (characteristic-two-construction.tex): let I₀ index the nonzero spaces HH²(A₀)_{χ_i} of Proposition 6.1, and let normalized S-relative two-cochains μ_i, i ∈ I₀, satisfy (1) each μ_i is homogeneous of character χ_i with nonzero class, (2) the family product m + Σ t_i μ_i is associative, (3) every binary fibre has the basis of kP as a normed multiplicative basis, and every scalar fibre has ray category P. Then a binary fibre is isomorphic to A, the transported basis is a normed multiplicative ray basis, and the isomorphism preserves each initial ray line up to a nonzero scalar.

    Here the rows and characters are those of Proposition 6.1 with their dual mesh weights (rowChar), I₀ is the set of rows with a nonzero class in positive internal degree (HH2Nonzero, I0), and A is any positive filtered deformation B of A₀ (familyCriterion_A0). The internal degree of μ_i is not assumed: it is the length coordinate of χ_i (RaySys.Sys.hasDeg₂_of_char). Associativity is required at every scalar parameter, which follows from associativity over the polynomial ring. Hypothesis (3) is stated on the fibre algebra itself (Fib (fibAM …)), and used for binary fibres; it is transported to B along the isomorphism (IsNormedMultiplicativeBasis.map_algEquiv, IsRayPres.map).

                Proposition 7.9 on A₀ (prop:family-criterion): for the rows and characters of Proposition 6.1 and any family μ_i, i ∈ I₀, of normalized S-relative cocycles of character χ_i with nonzero classes, whose family product is associative and whose binary fibres have the basis of kP as a normed multiplicative basis with ray category P: every positive filtered deformation B of A₀ is isomorphic to a binary fibre; the transported basis is a normed multiplicative ray basis of B presenting P, and the leading term of the image of each ray vector b_r is a nonzero multiple of b_r.
